title: ⚠️ Urgent threat notice
description: ConnectWise is investigating unauthorized access attempts involving its Cloud Backup service, formerly SkyKick, which integrates with Microsoft 365 environments. Suspicious authentication activity has been detected, and containment measures are in place. There is no current evidence that partner backup data has been accessed. Organizations using ConnectWise Cloud Backup are advised to review their Microsoft Entra enterprise applications for specific indicators of compromise and consider disabling the affected application temporarily. The investigation is ongoing, and ConnectWise will provide updates as available.
aiSummary: On October 16, 2026, ConnectWise published an advisory regarding suspicious authentication activity linked to its Cloud Backup environment, which may have allowed unauthorized access to customer Microsoft 365 tenants. The company has implemented containment measures and is actively investigating the scope and impact. Independent researchers have confirmed compromise involving the application's access, but ConnectWise reports no indication of partner backup data being accessed. Indicators of compromise include a specific application ID and an IP address. Organizations are recommended to review authentication logs and consider disabling the affected enterprise application while the investigation continues.
aiImpact: Potential unauthorized access to customer Microsoft 365 environments via the ConnectWise Cloud Backup application could lead to exposure of tenant data or disruption of backup services. However, ConnectWise currently reports no evidence of data access or exfiltration. The presence of the application alone does not confirm compromise. Temporary disabling of the application may disrupt backup operations.
